name: High Protein "Peaches & Cream" Cottage Cheese Pudding

instructions.primary_message: Drain and small dice peaches. Place in a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (15 oz) can sliced peaches in juice

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and zest lemon into the bowl with the peaches. Add honey and cinnamon, then stir to combine. (Reserve lemon for another use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
½ lemon
½ tbsp honey
¼ tsp cinnamon, ground

instructions.primary_message: Place cottage cheese, additional honey, and salt in a food processor. Blend on high until mixture is completely smooth, scraping down the sides of the processor with a silicone spatula as needed, 1-2 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cups cottage cheese
2 ½ tbsp honey
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Add half of the peach mixture to the processor, then pulse 5-7 times to combine. Divide pudding between four ramekins or glasses, smoothing the tops flat with the back of a spoon. Cover and chill for 1 hour. (Refrigerate remaining peach mixture for serving.)
To serve, top puddings with reserved peaches and enjoy!
